senses.gloss: कुम्भ- + उलूक कुम्भ- + उलूक, m. A kind of owl, MBh. 13, 5499.
कुम्भ- + कर्ण कुम्भ- + कर्ण, m. 1. a name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10350. 2. the name of a Rākṣasa, Rām. 1, 3, 34. []
† कुमार् कुमार्, i. 10 (rather a denom. derived from the next), Par. To play as a child.

कुमार कुमार, i. e. कु-मृ + अ (vb. मृ in its original signification, To be weak),
 I. m.
 1. A child (ved.).
 2. A boy, Man. 7, 152.
 3. A youth, Ragh. 3, 40.
 4. When compounded, often: Young, as latter part, Śāk. 27, 15; Ragh. 3, 40; as former part, Man. 3, 159. From early youth.
 5. A young prince, Ragh. 12, 41.
 6. A name of Skanda, the god of war, Suśr. 2, 394, 10.
 7. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 1870.
 II. f. री.
 1. A girl, Man. 3, 54.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 1, 3796.
 3. The name of a river, MBh. 6, 343.
 --Comp.

कुमारक कुमार + क,
 I. m.
 1. A boy, Śāk. 50, 1.
 2. A youth, Bhāg. P. 3, 3, 24.
 3. The name of a Nāga or serpent, MBh. 1, 2154.
 II. f. रिका, A girl, Pañc. 184, 4.
कुमारत्व कुमार + त्व, n. Youth, Ragh. 17, 30.
कुमारसू कुमार-सू, m. A name of Agni, MBh. 2, 1148.
† कुमाल् कुमाल् = कुमार् (v. r.).
कुमुद् कु-मुद्, n. The esculent white water-lily, Nymphæa esculenta, Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 38.

कुमुद कु-मुद् + अ,
 I. m. and n. The white esculent water-lily, Nymphæa esculenta, Pañc. 50, 10.
 II. m. The name of a Nāga or serpent, MBh. 1, 1560; of a celestial being, Bhāg. P. 7, 8, 39; of a monkey, Rām. 4, 39, 37; of a mountain, Bhāg. P. 5, 16, 12; of a man, Rājat. 5, 422.
कुमुदिनी कुमुदिनी, i. e. कुमुद + इन् + ई, f. A group of lotus flowers, Pañc. i. d. 152.

कुमुद्वन्त् कुमुद् + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Abounding in lotusses, Ragh. 4, 19.
 II. f. वती,
 1. A group of lotus flowers, Śāk. d. 65.
 2. A plant, Menyanthes indica, Suśr. 2, 251, 18.
 3. A proper name, Ragh. 16, 85.
† कुम्प् कुम्प्, i. 10, Par., v. r. of कुम्ब्, i. 10.
† कुम्ब् कुम्ब्, i. 1, and i. 10 (cf. the last and the next), To cover.

† कुम्भ् कुम्भ्, i. 10, Par., v. r. of कुम्ब्.
 --Cf. the last and the next.

कुम्भ कुम्भ् + अ (the vb. कुम्भ्, कुभ्, [] from which this noun is derived, is lost in the corresponding signification, but cf. कुब्ज, κυϕός, κύϕων, κῦϕος; Engl. hump; O.H.G. hofar; Lat. cŭbitus, the elbow, lying, etc., cŭbare, concumbere, etc.; and at the end of this article. From these and other instances, we may infer that the original signification of the vb. कुभ् was ‘to be crooked’),
 I. m., and f. भी.
 1. A pot, Man. 11, 186; MBh. 18, 84.
 2. A measure of grain, equal to twenty droṇas, Man. 8, 320; 4, 7.
 II. m.
 1. dual, The two frontal globes of an elephant, which swell in the rutting season, Pañc. i. d. 351.
 2. The paramour of a harlot, Śṛṅgārat. 9.
 3. The name of a Dānava, MBh. 1, 2527; of a Rākṣasa, Rām. 5, 79, 15.
 --Comp.
 --When latter part of a comp. adj. the fem. is भा, e. g. वारि-पूरित-कुम्भ, adj., f. भा, Bearing jars filled with water, Kathās. 18, 339.
 --Cf. κῡϕος, a vessel, κύϕελλον, κυψέλη, κύβος, κύβιτον, κύβη, κύμβος, κύμβαχος, etc.; Goth. hups; O.H.G. huf; A.S. hipe; O.H.G. hufila, ‘a cheek,’ hûfo and hauf, a multitude, heap; cf. supra.

कुम्भक कुम्भ + क,
 I. m. A religious exercise, closing the nostrils and mouth so as to suspend breathing, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 18.
 II. f. भिका, A small pot, Kathās. 6, 41.
कुम्भकार कुम्भ-कार, m. A potter, Pañc. 217, 20.
कुम्भकारिका कुम्भकारिका, i. e. कुम्भ-कारक, f. The wife of a potter, Kathās. 21, 134.
कुम्भिल कुम्भिल (akin to कुम्भ), m. A thief, Śāk. 13, 2 (Prākṛ.).
कुम्भीर कुम्भीर (akin to कुम्भ), m. A crocodile, MBh. 13, 5457.
कुम्भ- + जन्मन् कुम्भ- + जन्मन्, m. a name of Agastya, Ragh. 12, 31.
कुमुदिनी- + नायक कुमुदिनी- + नायक, m. the moon, Hit. 9, 5. -गण-, m. 1. the chief of the retinue of a god, Bhāg. P. 5, 17, 3. 2. the god Gaṇeśa, MBh. 1, 77.
कुम्भी- + पाक कुम्भी- + पाक, m. sing. and pl. the name of a hell in which the wicked are baked like potters' vessels, Man. 12, 76.
कुमारी-पुर कुमारी-पुर, n. a gynæceum.
कुमार-भृत्या कुमार-भृत्या, f. the fostering of a child, Ragh. 3, 12.
कु-मनीष कु-मनीष, adj. stupid, Bhāg. P. 1, 3, 37.
कु- + मनीषिन् कु- + मनीषिन्, adj. stupid, Bhāg. P. 4, 31, 21.
कु- + मित्त्र कु- + मित्त्र, n. a treacherous friend, Pañc. iii. d. 61.
कुम्भ- + योनि कुम्भ- + योनि, m. epithet of Agastya, Ragh. 4, 21.

कुम्भ- + रेतस् कुम्भ- + रेतस्,
 I. n. semen virile contained in a jar, MBh. 13, 7372.
 II. m. a name of Agni, MBh. 3, 14139.
कुम्भ- + संभव कुम्भ- + संभव, adj., m. epithet of Agastya, Bhāg. P. 6, 3, 35.
